summary: AI-focused full-stack developer building agentic, LLM-powered applications and automation pipelines - from AI-routed SaaS products to autonomous job-search and outreach systems. Comfortable across the stack (Next.js/React, Node.js, Python), with hands-on experience integrating OpenAI, Groq, and Claude into production workflows using agentic coding tools and orchestration frameworks like n8n and GitHub Actions.

bullets: Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) under a custom AGENTS.md workflow framework to maintain consistent architecture and automate delivery across parallel client projects.
Design and build production client web applications end-to-end using Next.js and React, managing the full lifecycle from Figma handoff through deployment on Vercel.
Independently manage client acquisition, scoping, and delivery as a solo digital agency, handling proposals through post-launch support.
Build a reusable library of niche-specific demo web applications to speed up client onboarding and delivery.
Integrated backend APIs built with Node.js and MongoDB into the production frontend, enabling smooth product flows and real-time updates.
Built and maintained the company's e-commerce frontend, improving page load speed by ~20% through targeted optimizations.
Collaborated with designers and backend engineers to shorten feature delivery cycles by ~15%, keeping frontend changes and backend updates fully aligned.
Implemented secure JWT authentication flows and reusable component patterns, reducing code duplication by ~25%.
Built scalable interfaces with React, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand, improving UI responsiveness by ~30%.

projects.name: BidCopy
projects.stack: Next.js, Supabase, Clerk, Razorpay, Gemini API, Claude API
bullets: Built an AI-powered bid-proposal SaaS product with tiered model routing - Gemini for the free tier, Claude Sonnet for paid users - balancing cost and output quality.
Designed the backend data layer and authentication using Supabase and Clerk, with Razorpay for subscription billing.
Built a companion Chrome Extension that calls the core AI API for in-context proposal generation directly from bid listing pages.

projects.name: Automated Job Application Pipeline
projects.stack: Python, Groq, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Google Sheets
bullets: Architected an agentic pipeline that discovers job listings, scores them against multiple resume variants using Groq (Llama 3.3 70B), and auto-tailors resume content per listing.
Built a multi-source discovery layer combining free job-board APIs and Playwright-based scraping, with fail-soft error handling so one broken source doesn't block the run.
Orchestrated the full pipeline on GitHub Actions with scheduled runs and Google Sheets logging for auditability.

projects.name: Stackform Cold Outreach Pipeline
bullets: Built an agentic outreach pipeline that scrapes prospect websites, scores site staleness (0-100), and drafts personalized outreach emails using Groq.
Designed a resilient scraping layer with Firecrawl as the primary source and a DuckDuckGo/BeautifulSoup fallback for reliability.
Used Google Sheets as a lightweight CRM with region-aware pricing logic (INR/USD) built into the outreach flow.
